title: Customer issue reporting notifications + admin past/expired bookings highlighting

requirements.summary: Make the customer booking issue reporting action clearly visible and ensure admin receives and visually distinguishes issue notifications in the admin Notifications panel via existing localStorage-based notification flows.
acceptanceCriteria: On the customer "My Bookings" page, each booking card provides a "Report Issue" action that opens the existing ReportIssueDialog.
Submitting the issue successfully shows the customer success message and persists the issue via existing issueStorage.
Submitting an issue adds a permanent admin notification with category "issues" (via existing addPermanentNotification usage).

In the admin NotificationPanel, issue notifications are grouped under the "issues" category and are visually distinct from other categories (e.g., red icon/badge/left accent bar as implemented for 'issues').
At least one issue notification created from the customer flow appears in the admin NotificationPanel without requiring a page reload (i.e., updates via the existing storage/event listeners).

file_operations.description: Ensure each booking card has a clearly visible "Report an Issue" action by adjusting the existing ReportIssueDialog trigger button label/styling for prominence while continuing to open the existing ReportIssueDialog. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Fix live-update wiring so newly created permanent notifications (including category "issues" from the customer flow) appear without reload by listening to the actual events dispatched by notificationStorage (e.g., notificationsUpdated and/or newNotification) and refreshing permanentNotifications accordingly, while keeping issue-specific color/accents and grouping under "issues". Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Show past bookings in admin Booking Management and visually distinguish expired bookings (checkOutDate earlier than current client time) without changing existing status counts/badges.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Booking Management shows both upcoming/active bookings and past bookings (no past bookings are hidden/omitted).
A booking is considered "expired" when its checkOutDate is earlier than the current time (client time).
Expired bookings are visually differentiated (e.g., muted/grey card styling and/or an "Expired" badge with a distinct color) while keeping existing status badges (confirmed/pending/cancelled) intact.
Expired styling is applied consistently to every expired booking in the list.
The bookings summary/counts remain correct and continue to reflect underlying booking.status values as before.

file_operations.description: Add an "expired" UI treatment based on client-time comparison (checkOutDate < Date.now()) by applying muted/grey styling to expired booking cards and rendering an additional "Expired" badge while preserving existing status badges and leaving the existing summary counts based on booking.status unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
